sharedFileOwnership.rule: Only svc-p08 is dispatched. Its writePaths are disjoint from all accepted plan paths, and sharedPaths is empty. In run 11 the worker edits only design-docs/specs/design-service-split-verification.md and its own plan (Status, Completion Criteria, Progress Log), plus a root-cause fix inside its own test writePaths only if a gate actually fails. It never edits: this manifest, the g1-g10 manifests, impl-plans/README.md, impl-plans/logs/**, README.md, src/**, db/**, impl-plans/active/inventory-alert-boundaries.md, or another plan's files. It never runs git checkout, restore, stash, reset, clean, commit, add or push. Per-edit discipline: read the file fresh before each edit; record pre/post SHA-256 hashes and an immutable intent snapshot under the evidence root; check for drift. If an owned file's hash changed outside the worker's own edits, write a Reconciliation request and never overwrite it.
sharedFileOwnership.dependencies: No dependency or lockfile change. Do not run uv lock or edit pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/web/package.json or src/web/bun.lock.
sharedFileOwnership.reconciliation: A defect in production code or in an accepted plan's file is a Reconciliation request in the svc-p08 Progress Log, reproduced by a failing test id. Owner diagnosis rule: serial finalization reproduces it and fixes the root cause in the owning plan's paths; workers never make cross-plan edits. Directory-stream GAP/conflict retries are expected behavior, not a defect.

Nodetto layout fix (design-service-split.md section 12). It is still pending at 66531bd; the JSONL was last changed in 19074e9. This edit is visual only. In db/schema/telescreen.nodetto.jsonl, change only the x/y of the 12 service-split erd.table elements and the width/height of the frames f-projections, f-inventory-links, f-notification-handoff and f-service-audit. Each table must lie inside the frame of its model module: projections.py -> f-projections; inventory_links.py -> f-inventory-links; notification_handoff.py -> f-notification-handoff; service_audit.py -> f-service-audit. Then run mise run ddl-arrange and mise run ddl-export. git diff --exit-code db/schema/telescreen.postgresql.sql db/schema/telescreen.sqlite.sql must exit 0. Keep the module-to-frame map as a tuple of pairs, because typelint forbids dict types. uv run --frozen pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/db/test_nodetto_schema.py and mise run ddl-check must both exit 0. Leave the 11 older frameless inventory handoff tables unchanged.

nonGoals: No production code, DDL, migration, test or example change in svc-p08 unless a gate actually fails and the root cause is in svc-p08 writePaths.

constraints: English only, no emojis. Plans under 400 lines. Python files under 1000 lines.
Strict typing (typelint, ruff ANN/PGH, ty). No Any, object, dict or **kwargs, and no type-ignore.
Raw detected values, raw item keys and source content never enter any table, log, outbox, replica, wire message, notification, export or API response.
